notes.title: Steam Visual Novel Fest Is Here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The Steam Visual Novel Fest is here and we're super excited to let you know that Fires At Midnight is part of the event!

During the event, you can grab Fires At Midnight for 30% off! If you already have the game, why not get it as a gift for a special someone? Don't miss out on this chance!

Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoy the game! Be sure to share your thoughts in your review and talk to us more over on our Discord server.

With love,
PTG Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37666516/55e8b7e10486d2bcd19682c9a3dec350bbfc2011.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Kabaret is LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37666516/d8d7cb19cc15e5f27160e25d5db0cb1d5228525e.png[/img][h1][b]Hello FAMs,[/b][/h1]

If you have been following our social media, we announced that we are now working on our second game, a Southeast Asian folklore adventure game, [b]Kabaret[/b], and is now live on Steam!

It has been a long and arduous journey for us here at Persona Theory Games to get here but we are just getting started.

We also have a special announcement to make...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37666516/bb1b6f40373268a0a5990c04687912c13b922941.png[/img]

We will be streaming our demo this Saturday on our Discord server at 9.00pm (UTC+8). If you have a spare hour, please drop by!

[i]Click on the banner[/i]
[url=bit.ly/PTGames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37666516/f218c9ceacfba5c4d824d3e45588814314873338.png[/img][/url]

There will also be a special event happening there as well.

So come and join us for a cup of tea or two. If you like what you see, feel free to share it. Tell your family and friends, dogs and cats, house pests and the demon you meet in your sleep at night because we have enough tea for everyone.

[i]Terima kasih[/i], and have a great weekend ahead! Stay safe and stay hydrated!

notes.title: Fires at Midnight is LIVE
notes.content:
Hi guys!

We’re happy to announce that Fires at Midnight is officially LIVE.

We can’t wait to hear from you. Tell us what you think, and if you encounter any bugs, please report at the community hub.

Enjoy the trip back to 1999.

[i]Let Love Burn[/i].

Follow us on Twitter for more updates!

From the devs <3 
Team Persona Theory
